The '''Great Creator''' was the revered deity of the [[Tuhgri]]. They believed that since the Great Creator had provided them with everything they would need to survive on their [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], then no individual could own anything. This became their most basic law, and the concept of personal property was alien to them.
